title: Deterministic CMK Routing and Audit Token Bridge for Region-Pinned Workloads
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Adds deterministic CMK selection for region-pinned tenants and an Audit Token Bridge that signs selection proofs for compliance ingestion; no customer-facing API changes.
description: Summary: Introduce a deterministic CMK selection algorithm (DKSP) and an Audit Token Bridge to provide verifiable, privacy-preserving proofs of key selection for region-pinned workloads. Motivation: customers operating under data residency constraints require deterministic, auditable routing of encryption operations to region-appropriate CMKs while minimizing disclosure of key identifiers to downstream services and logs. This PR implements a deterministic selection function based on tenant affinity, region policy and key-rotation epoch, an opaque audit-token envelope that proves which CMK was used without exposing raw key IDs, and RBAC v2 policy mappings that gate who can request or verify audit tokens. Design: (1) DKSP: a small deterministic hash that combines tenant_id, region_tag, and rotation_epoch and maps to a stable cmk-alias-anchor; fallback rules route to regional fallback pools if mapping is missing. (2) Audit Token Bridge: service-side component that mints a signed envelope (audit_token) containing a blinded reference to the CMK alias, a signed nonce, and a compliance assertion. The token is verifiable by compliance tooling using the platform's audit public key; verification returns only "alias-hash" and compliance attributes, not plaintext key ARN. (3) RBAC v2: new attribute-driven policies that add "kms:verify-audit-token" and "kms:mint-audit-token" permissions scoped to service principals and linear-linked tickets. (4) Private installer hooks: installer performs a preflight to verify local CMK alias registrations and deploys local verifier keys for air-gapped customers. Testing and rollout: unit + integration tests added; e2e ran across us-west-2, eu-central-1 and a simulated air-gapped environment. Rollout uses a staged feature flag gated by ENG-2146 and SEC-802; initial rollout to Dedicated customers with region-pin opt-in. Backout plan: feature flag toggle and a deterministic fallback to legacy round-robin CMK allocator. Security review notes: keys are never exported; audit tokens rotate with audit key TTL and are short-lived (5m by default). Compliance owners validated token schema and verifier workflow. Checklist: [x] design doc linked (ENG-2146) [x] unit tests [x] kms integration tests [x] policy matrix update [x] private-installer integration
